import subprocess, os
ENV = dict(os.environ)
ENV['DISPLAY'] = ':0'

print('=== 测试1: xclip clipboard ===')
r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
print('内容:', repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()[:50]))
print('错误:', r.stderr.decode()[:50])

print('\n=== 测试2: xclip primary ===')
r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'primary', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
print('内容:', repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()[:50]))

print('\n=== 测试3: xdotool getactivewindow ===')
r = subprocess.run(['xdotool', 'getactivewindow'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
print('活动窗口:', r.stdout.decode().strip())

print('\n=== 测试4: xsel ===')
r = subprocess.run(['xsel', '--clipboard', '--output'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
print('xsel 内容:', repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()[:50]))
PYEOF
